fact: The Statistical Programmes Committee (CPE), chaired by INEGE's director general, held its seventh ordinary session in Malabo and took the 2025 implementation report of the ENDE and the ENDE 2026 annual action plan.
The document treats the ENDE as the strategy in implementation, with a 2025 implementation report and a 2026 annual action plan; it gives no period or adoption date.

The National Statistics Council held its eighth ordinary session of 2026, with the ENDE 2025 implementation report on the agenda for presentation and validation (agenda-style report, written in the present tense).
The document treats the ENDE as the strategy in implementation, with a 2025 implementation report; it gives no period or adoption date.
A draft institutional order creating the team to draft the successor strategy, ENDE 2027-2031, was on the council's agenda.

The Council of Ministers approved the draft decree on the national statistics development strategy (ENDE), presented by the Ministry of Planning; it has four strategic axes, 15 operational objectives, 54 expected results and 218 activities.

The document is the Estrategia Nacional de Desarrollo de la Estadística (ENDE) 2022-2026, a five-year national plan prepared by INEGE with the Executive Committee (CPE) evaluating it and the National Statistics Council (CNE) validating it; no adoption date is given, so as_of is the document's published date.

The document states the earlier ENDE 2016-2020 was adopted as the national reference framework for statistics and ran to 2020, with 47.8% of its activities done, 37.7% not done and 14.5% under way; the period has ended.

The ENDE 2022-2026 logical framework states the successor ENDE (variously 2027-2031 or 2027-2032) is being drafted under INEGE with CPE validation, with CNE validation and government adoption targeted for the second half of 2026; as_of is the document's published date.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): SNDS 2022-2026.
